description: Angular component for customer management page, including UI logic for listing, searching, pagination, and deletion of customers.

classes.name: CustomersPageComponent
classes.description: Angular component managing customer list, search, pagination, and delete operations.

methods.name: refresh
methods.description: Fetches customer data from the service and updates the component state.

methods.name: onSearchChange
methods.description: Handles search input changes with debounce, triggers data refresh.

methods.name: setPageSize
methods.description: Sets the number of items per page and refreshes data.

methods.name: prev
methods.description: Navigates to the previous page of customer list.

methods.name: next
methods.description: Navigates to the next page of customer list.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Deletes a customer and updates the list accordingly.
